d: Author Suketu Mehta has described the Democrats' election victories as 'Diwali' for Indian Americans, highlighting the struggles of the Indian-origin community in the United States. Drawing attention to Indian Americans' success several fields like in spelling bee competitions, Mehta argues that their achievements do not necessarily translate into acceptance. He says sections of the Republican political establishment continue to push an idea of 'White America' that leaves Indian-origin communities feeling excluded.
